title: Date Night
theme: Romance: park dining, proposals and love songs
intro: [excited] Good evening, lovebirds! Tonight's episode is DATE NIGHT: candlelit dinners, big proposals and love songs. [chuckles] Fix your hair, check your breath... because we are about to get ROMANTIC.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A candlelit table for two on a balcony overlooking a glowing fairy-tale castle at twilight, fireworks blooming in a violet sky, rose petals on a white tablecloth, two crystal glasses catching the light.

categories.title: Bella Notte
categories.intro: First up, Lady and the Tramp, the most romantic plate of pasta in movie history. [laughs] Slurp responsibly.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A checkered-tablecloth table in a cozy back alley behind an Italian restaurant at night, a single plate of spaghetti and meatballs, a flickering candle in a wax-covered bottle, moonlight and string lights overhead.

clues.clue: In Lady and the Tramp's famous dinner date, the two dogs share a plate of this pasta.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is spaghetti! [chuckles] One noodle, two dogs, and the most famous accidental smooch of all time.

clues.clue: Restaurant owner Tony serenades the dogs with Bella Notte alongside this cook.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Joe! Tony plays the accordion, Joe plays the mandolin, and the dogs get a free concert.

clues.clue: During the spaghetti dinner, Tramp politely pushes the last meatball over to Lady using this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his nose! [sighs] Honestly? More manners than most of MY dates.

clues.clue: Translated from Italian, the song title Bella Notte means this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is beautiful night! And it's the perfect name for a song sung by two guys in aprons in an alley.

clues.clue: Released in 1955, Lady and the Tramp was Disney's first animated feature filmed in this widescreen process.
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is CinemaScope! The artists had to widen their backgrounds, so there was even MORE alley for romance.

categories.title: Popping the Question
categories.intro: Proposals! Engagements! Royal weddings! [mischievously] And a few people who REALLY should have waited past the first date.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A tiny open ring box on a velvet cushion in a rose garden at sunset, a soft glowing sparkle where a ring would be, rose petals and fairy lights all around.

clues.clue: In Frozen, Anna agrees to marry this prince on the very same day she meets him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hans! [sarcastic] And THAT, kids, is why you date someone for more than one song.

clues.clue: In The Princess and the Frog, Tiana and Prince Naveen get married while they're both still these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is frogs! Then one kiss from the new princess, and POOF, back to human. Talk about a wedding surprise.

clues.clue: In Aladdin, the law says Princess Jasmine must marry a prince by this upcoming day.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is her birthday! [laughs] Most of us just want cake. Jasmine got a marriage deadline.

clues.clue: Princess Aurora was promised in marriage at birth to Prince Phillip, the son of this king.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is King Hubert! He and King Stefan planned the whole wedding before the bride could even crawl.

clues.clue: In Brave, the scrawny heir of this clan accidentally hits the bullseye while competing for Merida's hand.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dingwall! [chuckles] Wee Dingwall's lucky shot only happened because he jumped when the king yelled.

categories.title: Sing Me a Love Song
categories.intro: Time to finish the love song! I sing the line, you fill in the missing word. [whispers] Please don't make me actually sing.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An old jukebox glowing pink and gold in a dark ballroom, musical notes drifting up like fireflies, a single spotlight on an empty dance floor.

clues.clue: Finish the Lion King lyric: Can you feel the love blank?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is tonight! [laughs] Timon and Pumbaa were NOT happy about it.

clues.clue: Finish the Beauty and the Beast lyric: Tale as old as time, true as it can blank.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is be! Sung by a teapot, which is still the most romantic thing a teapot has ever done.

clues.clue: Finish the Tangled lyric: All those blank outside looking in.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is years! [sighs] Eighteen years in a tower, and all she wanted was to see some lanterns.

clues.clue: Finish the Cinderella lyric: So this is love, so this is what makes life blank.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is divine! Cinderella waltzes, the Grand Duke closes the curtains, and the clock starts ticking toward midnight.

clues.clue: Finish the Frozen lyric: Our mental synchronization can have but one blank.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is explanation! [mischievously] Spoiler: the explanation was that Hans was a TERRIBLE guy.

categories.title: Table for Two
categories.intro: Disney Parks date night! Look at the picture and name the restaurant. [chuckles] Reservations not included.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An elegant restaurant table set for two beside tall arched windows, chandeliers glowing, a distant castle lit up outside, linen napkins folded like roses.

clues.clue: At Disneyland, couples can dine beside the boats of Pirates of the Caribbean under a sky that's always twilight at this restaurant.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Blue Bayou Restaurant! [whispers] Fireflies, crickets, and a little splash from passing pirates. So romantic.

clues.clue: Atop Disney's Riviera Resort, this rooftop restaurant is named for Mickey Mouse's name in Italian.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Topolino's Terrace! Topolino means Mickey in Italian. [chuckles] Fireworks views AND pasta. Bellissimo.

source.author: Eden, Janine and Jim from New York City

clues.clue: At Hollywood Studios, couples can eat in booths shaped like classic cars while watching old sci-fi clips under a starry sky at this restaurant.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant! [laughs] The only drive-in where the car never needs gas.

source.author: Josh Hallett from Winter Haven, FL, USA

clues.clue: Atop Disney's Contemporary Resort, diners at this restaurant can watch Magic Kingdom fireworks through the windows.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is California Grill! They even pipe the fireworks music into the dining room. [whispers] Very smooth move for a proposal.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sleek modern rooftop restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows, warm wood and soft lighting, looking out over a lake toward a distant castle under bursting fireworks.

clues.clue: Disney's Grand Floridian is home to this famously fancy tasting-menu restaurant, named for a British royal couple.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Victoria and Albert's! Named for Queen Victoria and Prince Albert, the original royal power couple.

categories.title: Emoji Love Stories
categories.intro: Our fan category tonight: Emoji Love Stories! I show you emojis, you name the romantic film. [chuckles] Heart eyes encouraged.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A glowing smartphone-like pane of light floating over a moonlit lake, made of soft pastel hearts, stars and bubbles, with no symbols or letters, dreamy bokeh.

clues.clue: 🧜‍♀️❤️🤴🦀 Hint: she gave up her voice for legs.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Little Mermaid! [sighs] Ariel traded her voice for a boy she met ONCE. Bold strategy.

clues.clue: 👸🕳️🗽💍 Hint: a cartoon princess pops out of a manhole into real New York City.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Enchanted! [laughs] Giselle cleans an apartment with pigeons and rats. True love conquers ALL... even New York.

clues.clue: 🏮🏮👸🍳 Hint: a tower, a thief and a very handy kitchen tool.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tangled! [laughs] Frying pans: who knew, right?

clues.clue: 🤖❤️🤖🌱 Hint: a trash-compacting robot falls for a sleek probe.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is WALL-E! He held hands with a robot named EVE, and every grown-up in the theater cried.

clues.clue: ☔💙☔❤️🌧️ Hint: a Pixar short about two umbrellas falling in love on a rainy city street.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Blue Umbrella! A blue umbrella and a red umbrella meet in the rain... and the whole CITY helps them get together.
